neighbours.label: the repeated noun in an emphatic restatement set off by dashes (this work -- your work)
fire: This house -- our house -- has stood here for a hundred years.
That decision -- my decision -- cost the team the match.
The money -- their money -- was spent on a new roof.
This garden -- her garden -- is full of roses every June.
That song -- his song -- played on every radio that summer.
The land -- our land -- was taken without a word.
This vote -- your vote -- will shape the next ten years.
That letter -- her letter -- never reached the soldier.
quiet: This house has stood here on the hill for a hundred years.
That decision by the coach cost the team the match.
The money from the fair was spent on a new roof.
This garden behind the school is full of roses every June.
That song by the band played on every radio that summer.
The land by the river was taken without a word.
This vote in the spring will shape the next ten years.
That letter from home never reached the soldier.
